newsitem.title: USA: Oregon unemployment rate hits 5.6 pct - state.
newsitem.headline: Oregon unemployment rate hits 5.6 pct - state.

text.p: Oregon's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate rose one-tenth of a percentage point to 5.6 percent in February, state officials said in a report on Tuesday.
This slight rise put Oregon above the national rate of 5.3 percent in February, the state Employment Department said in its monthly report.
The department said, however, that seasonally adjusted job gains in February totaled 6,200 in the nonfarm sector, boosting the average monthly gain over the past four months to 4,700 jobs.

"Oregon's economy continues to expand," said David Cooke, an economist with the Employment Department. "The relatively low unemployment rate coupled with strong job growth are primary indicators of a healthy economy."
